products.name: Notion Q&A
products.note: Knowledge base AI Q&A; workspace corpus access; permission-aware but broad exposure risk

profile_text.body:
Notion Labs is a for-profit startup founded in 2013 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company builds Notion, a productivity workspace, and describes it as one tool covering search, generation, analysis, and chat. Its site markets the platform as handling documents, tasks, databases, and connected third-party apps such as Slack and Google Drive in a single environment.

Notion AI is the company's embedded AI product, built directly into Notion pages, docs, tasks, and databases. It includes Notion Q&A for searching across a workspace and connected apps, AI Meeting Notes for transcription and summarization, Enterprise Search with Notion AI Connectors, and Custom Agents that run on schedules or triggers to complete multi-step work autonomously. Notion AI is included with Business and Enterprise plans, and Custom Agents run on a credit system available as an add-on priced at $10 per 1,000 credits. The company states that Notion AI enables HIPAA compliance through LLM providers' zero-retention APIs, that customer data is not used to train models unless users opt in, and that contractual agreements with AI subprocessors prohibit use of customer data for model training.

The site's held facts show Notion Labs carries 174 law-exposure entries in California, which is consistent with its San Francisco headquarters and California's litigation environment, though no specific cases are recorded in the data. The company has a tracked presence on this site with two registered AI products, Notion AI and Notion Q&A, and no MCP server listing on record.
